Enum Class PhysicalShockType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PhysicalShockType>
org.ether.society.model.PhysicalShockType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PhysicalShockType>, Constable
public enum PhysicalShockType extends Enum<PhysicalShockType>

Physical Shock Type

Strongly-typed enumeration of physical, climatic, astronomical, and socio-ecological shocks applied to planetary mesh cells and atmospheric buffers.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
